cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name is on bathroom duty. I taught you to use this mop; it's time you took it without being asked twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You get the floor much cleaner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Flattery has improved since last week. The floor won't. Take the mop and show me what you remember.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you do the first bit so I can copy you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll talk you through it. Take the mop with both hands; you don't need mine for that part.

reason: Remove the implied unspoken handover and mechanism summary; A now plainly refuses to take the tool while offering verbal guidance.
